results.title: A hanging proviso qualifies every preceding clause of its section
results.legalStatement: 7.05's trailing 'provided further that the foregoing shall not permit any Disposition of the Borrower's principal manufacturing facility' qualifies clauses (a)–(l) alike; compiling any clause must see it.

verdicts.check: compiling 7.05(a) sees the hanging proviso
compiling 7.05(j) sees the hanging proviso
compiling 7.05(k) sees the hanging proviso
the section-level operative text carries the proviso

results.title: A same-document 'notwithstanding Section X' provision governs the section it names
results.legalStatement: A new Section 7.05 reading 'Notwithstanding Section 7.01(b), the aggregate principal amount … shall not exceed $10,000,000 … while any Lien permitted under Section 7.02 is outstanding' restricts 7.01(b); compiling 7.01 and asking about 7.01(b) must bring 7.05 in.

verdicts.check: section-level 7.01 bundle carries 7.05
hybrid closure for a 7.01(b) question includes 7.05
clause-level 7.01(b) bundle carries 7.05 (production candidates are section-level; recorded only)

results.title: A cap outside the covenant article (Article IX 'notwithstanding anything in Article VII') governs
results.legalStatement: 9.15 caps all secured Indebtedness at $25,000,000 notwithstanding Article VII; compiling 7.01 or 7.02 must see 9.15.

verdicts.check: section-level 7.01 bundle carries 9.15
section-level 7.02 bundle carries 9.15
clause-level 7.01(b) bundle carries 9.15 (recorded only)
clause-level 7.02(b) bundle carries 9.15 (recorded only)

From that date the ratio basket 7.01(c) must be compiled against the new definition; the other definitions in Section 1.01 are untouched; before that date nothing changes.

results.title: An amendment whose effectiveness is conditional is not applied before the condition is evidenced
results.legalStatement: Amendment No. 3 restates 7.01(d) but becomes effective only on the 'Amendment No. 3 Effective Date' (counterparts received, fee paid). With no evidence of that date, 7.01(d) must not read as amended at 2026-06-30 and the instrument state must not claim RESOLVED.

verdicts.check: the effect's effective date is not a concrete date

results.title: Cache identity: a compiled unit is reusable when its own text and context are unchanged, and never reused when its text changed
results.legalStatement: Inserting a proviso into 7.01(c) must not invalidate the cached compilation of 7.02 (text unchanged) and must invalidate 7.01's (text changed).

verdicts.check: 7.02's semantic cache key is unchanged after an insertion earlier in the document
7.02's sourceContentVersion after the insertion (recorded: it may legitimately embed the positional node id)
